senses.gloss: (I)--the son of शशाद; rode on Indra in the form of a bull in the आडीवक युद्ध। Father of Anenas. वा. ८८. २४-25; Br. III. ६३. २५; Vi. IV. 2. ३२-3.
(II)--a surname of Puramjaya (s.v.); a son of विकुक्षि; lust of, after more territory; eldest of ११४ ruling south of Meru. भा. IX. 6. १२; XII. 3. १०; M. १२. २०.
--a मरीचि god. Br. IV. 1. ५८.
--a son of Satyaka and काशी king's daughter; his son, वृष्टि. वा. ९६. ११५-16.
--a brother of Vasudeva. Vi. IV. १४. ३०.
(I)--a Mt. of शाल्मलिद्वीप noted for pre- cious gems rained by वासव; a hill containing medicinal herbs, on the N. W. of the कैलास. Br. II. १९. ४१-2; M. १२१. १४; वा. ४९. ३८; Vi. II. 4. २७.
(II)--Mt. in कुशद्वीप. M. १२२. ६०.

--The eldest of Reva(ta)'s hundred sons. Father of रेवती (Surata-वा।) whom he took to ब्रह्मा for a suitable bridegroom. As ब्रह्मा was engaged in attending to music, the king waited, and afterwards the Creator laughingly said that it was past २७ × 4 युगस् since he came there. At that time was flourishing बलराम whose name was suggested for his daughter's husband. On return he found his country overrun by यक्षस्, and getting his daughter married to बलराम, he retired to Badari to [page१-296+ ३०] perform penance.
1: भा. IX. 3. २९-36; M. १२. २३; वा. ८६. २६-30; ८८. 1.
Ruled from कुशस्थलि. During his sojourn at ब्रह्मा's residence, the राक्षसस् captured the capital and put to flight his younger brothers who established smaller states then and there.
2: Br. III. ६१. २०-27; Vi. IV. 1. ६५-96.
--a राक्षस in Sutalam. Br. II. २०. २३.
--a hill in भारतवर्ष. भा. V. १९. १६.
--a daughter of दक्ष and a wife of Dharma. Mother of संकट. भा. VI. 6. 4 & 6.
--a commander who aided विषङ्ग; killed by वन्हिवासा. Br. IV. २५. २८ & ९५.
--a commander of विषङ्ग--also केकिवा- hana. Was killed by महावज्रेश्वरी. Br. IV. २५. २८ & ९६.
(I)--a राजऋषि becoming a ब्राह्मण. वा. ९१. ११७.

(III)--the son born of दीर्घतमस् to Bali's slave girl: Followed his father Gautama afterwards to Giri- vraja (Giripraja-वा। प्।) and got engaged in तपस्। Attained [page१-297+ २८] Brahmahood at the place with his brother चक्षुस्. Father of १००० sons known as कूष्माण्ड Gautamas and कृष्णाङ्- gas.
1: Br. III. ७४. ७१, ९५ & ९९; वा. ९९. ७०, ९३-7.
A मन्त्रकृत् and of the अङ्गिरस branch.
2: M. १४५. १०५; वा. ५९. १०२.

(II)--a sage who called on भीष्म on his death bed.
1: भा. 1. 9. 7.
An अङ्गिरस् and a मन्त्रकृत्; a क्षत्रोपेत- द्विज।
2: Br. II. ३२. १११; III. ६६. ८८.
(IV)--a pupil of पौष्पिञ्जि. Vi. III. 6. 6.
--a son born to the waiting woman of सुदेष्णा and दीर्घटमस्. By austerities at Girivraja, reached ब्राह्मणहोओद्. Father of १००० sons by name कौष्माण्डस् and Gautamas. M. ४८. ६३, ८४-8.
(I)--a son of भद्राश्व. M. ४९. 5.
(II)--one of the ten sons of रौद्राश्व. वा. ९९. १२४; Vi. IV. १९. 2.
(I)--(Mt.) a hill touching the sea. Br. II. १८. ७६.
(II)--a bird; a वाहन of सूचीमुख. Br. III. 7. ४५५; IV. २४. ४४.
--the वायस in ऐन्द्र, वारुण, वायव्य and नैरृत directions. वा. १११. ४०.
--son of शिशुनाग, (bha) and father of Kse- madharman. Ruled for ३६ years (२६ years-मत्स्य प्।). भा. XII. 1. 5; Br. III. ७४. १२९; M. २७२. 7; Vi. IV. २४. १०. ११.
--in गया, releases one from debts. वा. १०८. ७६.
--a place fit for performing श्राद्ध। Br. III. १३. ८५. [page१-344+ २६]
--a coin of small value. भा. XII. 3. ४१.
--the father of Gau who was married to Yati. Br. III. ६८. १३; वा. ९३. १४.
--a son of जटामालि, an अवतार् of the Lord. वा. २३. १८७.
--कृष्ण Para1s4ara. M. २०१. ३५.
